## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 432 captures during November 2025. Activity proceeded in line with the planned service arrangements, with session lists managed as expected apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the clinic maintained regular capture activity throughout the month. No additional operational exception is identified in the report.

## Image quality

Of the 432 captures, 25 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.8. The result is recorded for monitoring of image quality and indicates the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. Image-quality outcomes should continue to be reviewed through routine local processes so that any recurring causes can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 130 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides the reported measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading. Overall, the activity, image-quality, and grading figures provide the monthly operational position for West Gate Eye Clinic for November 2025. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave.
